name: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Youcare Pharmaceutical Group Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, distribution, and sale of pharmaceutical products. It offers drugs in various forms, such as injection, lyophilized powder injection, pills, tablets, capsules, ointments, creams, granules, etc. The company provides drugs in various categories, including covering cardio-cerebrovascular, antivirals, central nervous system medication, turbidity and lipid-lowering, gastrointestinal system, anti-infection, endocrinology anti-tumour and other therapeutic areas.
